read_file_contents: create a python script that uses ReadFile to read and print the contents of a given file path
read_file_suppress_errors: create a python script that uses ReadFile with print_error=False to silently handle missing files
read_file_for_cpp_parsing: build a python module that uses ReadFile to load C++ source files for parsing
test_ReadFile: test the ReadFile function by reading an existing file and verifying the returned content
review_ReadFile: review the ReadFile function and its error handling for IOError exceptions
